in_sanskrit.name: Anandhan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Joy, Happiness, Bliss
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anandhan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anandhan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ananda', meaning joy, happiness, and bliss. In Hindu mythology, Ananda is a name of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, who is often depicted as the embodiment of supreme joy and happiness.
